name: What steps can I take to maintain my windows after repair?

mainEntity.name: What steps can I take to maintain my windows after repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: After a window repair, regular maintenance can prolong its lifespan. Keep tracks clean and free of debris to ensure smooth operation. Lubricate moving parts like hinges and locks periodically with a silicone-based spray. Inspect seals and caulking annually for cracks or deterioration, re-caulking as needed to prevent leaks and drafts. Promptly address any new small issues to prevent them from escalating into more significant repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain windows post-repair by keeping tracks clean, lubricating moving parts, and inspecting seals/caulking annually. Address small issues promptly to prevent further damage.
